summary: Iteration 19 — full verification of the review-system upgrade (pin, anonymous/display_name, Decline vs Delete with lock query param). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_review_upgrade_v11.py (10 cases, all pass) covering: display_name is echoed in the public payload; anonymous=true masks to 'Valued Customer'; blank display_name falls back to 'Valued Customer' AND the DB stores anonymous=True; public /api/reviews never leaks user_email/order_id/user_id/real name (asserted both on keys and on raw response text); POST /admin/reviews/{id}/pin?pinned=true|false toggles and 404s on unknown id; unauthenticated call returns 401/403; both public and admin listings sort pinned first then newest; DELETE default lock=true wipes the review, sets review_declined on the order, and a second submission returns 400; DELETE ?lock=false wipes the review, leaves review_declined unset, and a fresh submission succeeds; regression: approve issues one single-use THANKS coupon locked to issued_to. Also re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_review_rewards_v10.py (9/9 green) as a regression on the approval-coupon rework. Playwright drove the preview URL end-to-end: (1) reviewqa_8787@gmail.com opened My Orders — the ReviewDialog display-name input was pre-filled with 'Casey' (the account first name); ticking review-anonymous-toggle removed review-name-input from the DOM and rendered review-anonymous-note; submission with a custom display_name AND a separate anonymous submission both landed on review-thanks + review-coupon-pending. (2) admin approved both, pinned one via pin-review-{id} → review-pinned-badge-{id} appeared; the pinned review then led the homepage carousel, the /products carousel (home-review-carousel now rendered on /products), and the /reviews page — the pinned card has data-testid review-card-pinned-{id} and appears at DOM index 0 (verified by querying the first review-card-* article). The pinned reviewer with anonymous=true rendered as 'Valued Customer' publicly; the named one rendered as 'ReviewerQA'. Unpinning removes the badge. decline-review-{id} and delete-review-{id} both render alongside the pin button and share admin-only DELETE /api/admin/reviews/{id} — the lock=false query param is confirmed sent by ReviewsTab.jsx (backend tests exercise both branches with real HTTP requests). No bugs found in the feature.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewsTab.jsx line 127 leaks the real user_email in the admin-only listing (fine for admin, but note the private admin payload still includes it — the public /api/reviews correctly omits it, so this is intentional; just calling it out for future audits).

server.py continues to grow (now 1767 lines). The Reviews block (create_review, review_status, public_reviews, list_reviews, pin_review, approve_review, delete_review) is a clean ~200-line unit and would move out to /app/backend/reviews.py cleanly. Still the top code-quality follow-up.

pin_review does not verify the target review is 'approved' before pinning — an admin could pin a pending review. Because public_reviews already filters by status='approved' this is only cosmetic in the admin list, but consider requiring approved status (or auto-approving on pin) to avoid surprising admins.

delete_review with lock=false also removes an approved review's coupon_code reference on the customer's My Orders page, but the previously-issued auto coupon is NOT revoked. If the intent of the 'plain Delete' is 'wipe for QA', consider also deleting the linked coupon so a redo review can issue a fresh one (otherwise issue_review_coupon's one_per_customer guard blocks the second coupon and the customer sees review-coupon-unavailable-{order}). Backend tests didn't hit this because they cleanup with mongo.reviews.delete_many, not the API.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (customer submit named + anonymous, admin approve+pin, homepage/products/reviews pinned first, unpin removes badge, decline+delete buttons present and wired)

The two persistent review-flow QA orders (6a9b5752c1032d87a97bd738 and 6a9b57e93acd4d6c08240c92) were used for the UI run and left clean: reviews wiped, review_declined unset, no leftover THANKS* coupons or redemptions for reviewqa_8787@gmail.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new suite with `pytest backend/tests/test_review_upgrade_v11.py -v -n 0`. It seeds/tears its own orders so it is safe to re-run. When driving the UI, remember: (1) login redirects to /dashboard, not /, so wait_for_url('**/') will time out — use wait_for_timeout(2000) after clicking ENTER, (2) the anonymous checkbox removes review-name-input from the DOM entirely (count==0), not just hides it, (3) the Turnstile widget errors on the preview host and the app posts turnstile_token='captcha-unavailable' — the review endpoint accepts any token because turnstile.bypassed_request returns True for preview hosts, (4) pinned review sorts *first in DOM* so `document.querySelector('article[data-testid^="review-card-"]')` is the leading (pinned) one across / , /products and /reviews. The QA account first name is 'Casey' — that's what the display-name input pre-fills with.
